typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	totblY14TradeTestingProductRatings_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		entrydate as date,
		prod_subtp as string,
		tpd_base_prod as string,
		SOR as string,
		RiskRating as string,
		prod_typ as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> fromtblY14TradeTestingStage1a
fromtblY14TradeTestingStage1a sink(input(
		entrydate as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		ProductSubType as string,
		tpd_base_prod as string,
		SOR as string,
		RiskRating as string,
		ProductType as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		entrydate,
		ProductSubType = prod_subtp,
		tpd_base_prod,
		SOR,
		RiskRating,
		ProductType = prod_typ),
	partitionFileNames:[($totblY14TradeTestingProductRatings_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> totblY14TradeTestingProductRatings
